mapper.select: SELECT DEPOSIT_PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, MINIMUM_AMOUNT, MAXIMUM_AMOUNT, TERM_MONTHS, INTEREST_RATE, EARLY_TERMINATION_RATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM FIXED_DEPOSIT_PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'ON_SALE'

SELECT DEPOSIT_PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, MINIMUM_AMOUNT, MAXIMUM_AMOUNT, TERM_MONTHS, INTEREST_RATE, EARLY_TERMINATION_RATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM FIXED_DEPOSIT_PRODUCT WHERE DEPOSIT_PRODUCT_ID = #{depositProductId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIXED_DEPOSIT_PRODUCT (DEPOSIT_PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, MINIMUM_AMOUNT, MAXIMUM_AMOUNT, TERM_MONTHS, INTEREST_RATE, EARLY_TERMINATION_RATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{depositProductId}, #{productName}, #{minimumAmount}, #{maximumAmount}, #{termMonths}, #{interestRate}, #{earlyTerminationRate}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
